fields.Name: AIUsageByUser
fields.UserQuestion: What is our AI usage, spend, and token volume per user for chargeback attribution?
fields.Description: Aggregates AI usage facts by UserID to support user-level chargeback, attribution, and consumption monitoring.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Aggregates vwAIUsageFacts by UserID and CostCurrency over model calls only (parallel parents excluded), with optional start/end on the base RunAt column. Computes runs, priced/unpriced run counts, own cost over priced runs, prompt and completion tokens, and the most recent run timestamp.
